summary: You're at a solid developing level across all your competencies, with attainment clustered between 51% and 55% - consistent core understanding that now needs deeper consolidation. Markers repeatedly note that your work meets requirements but needs more consistency and stronger justification of your design and implementation decisions. The clearest opportunity is to move from meeting the basics to explaining your reasoning with evidence. Let's focus on the lowest-scoring areas first, especially your communication and OO design work, while building on your steadier algorithms results.

priorities.evidence: This is your lowest competency at 51.5%. Your Milestone Presentation (49.0%) was flagged as limited with gaps requiring targeted revision of reporting outcomes and reflecting on feedback (CSE3CAP:SILO3), while the Final Presentation (52.0%) and Final Report (52.0%) also stayed at developing.
priorities.actions: Re-read the marker feedback on CSE3CAP:Oral presentation: Project Milestone Presentation and use its reporting and reflection themes to guide your revision. Rebuild the Final Presentation slides so each project outcome is stated once for a technical audience and once in plain terms (CSE3CAP:SILO3), and explain how you acted on feedback. For CSE3CAP:SILO4, compare CSE3CAP:Assignment: Final written Project Report against an industry documentation template and revise its structure, reasoning, and technical evidence where appropriate.

priorities.evidence: At 52.4%, this sits near the bottom. Your CSE1OOF:Practical demonstration (50.0%) was the weakest and CSE1OOF:Assignment (52.0%) and CSE1OOF:Central examination (53.0%) all drew the same note: consistency needed on OO design, code reuse and explaining design decisions.
priorities.actions: Revisit the feedback on CSE1OOF:Practical demonstration and CSE1OOF:Assignment, then re-attempt a small real-life design problem where you deliberately reuse a class through inheritance or composition (CSE1OOF:SILO3) and write a short paragraph justifying each design choice (CSE1OOF:SILO4). For CSE1OOF:SILO1, redo an exam-style modelling question from CSE1OOF:Central examination, drawing objects that combine data and behaviour.

priorities.evidence: At 52.5%, feedback on your CSE3CAP:Assignment: Final written Project Report (52.0%) and CSE3CAP:Assignment: Sprint Project management reports (53.0%) both flagged inconsistency in applying industry standard technical solutions (CSE3CAP:SILO2).
priorities.actions: Go back to your CSE3CAP:Assignment: Final written Project Report and identify where a recognised industry standard or convention should have been cited or followed, then rewrite that section to name and apply the standard explicitly (CSE3CAP:SILO2).

priorities.evidence: At 53.0%, your CSE3CAP:Assignment: Sprint Project management reports (53.0%) was noted as needing more consistency in advanced project management during development (CSE3CAP:SILO1).
priorities.actions: Review the marker comments on CSE3CAP:Assignment: Sprint Project management reports and re-draft one sprint report so it clearly tracks planned versus actual progress and documents decisions made during implementation (CSE3CAP:SILO1).
